import os
import sqlite3
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from task_api import TaskAPI


class Independent(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_security_and_recovery(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = os.path.join(directory, "release.db")
            app = TaskAPI(path)
            started = time.monotonic()
            for index in range(100):
                self.assertEqual(
                    app.request("POST", "/tasks", {"title": f"Task {index}"})[0], 201
                )
            self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 10)
            title = "'); DROP TABLE tasks; --"
            self.assertEqual(app.request("POST", "/tasks", {"title": title})[0], 201)
            app = TaskAPI(path)
            self.assertEqual(len(app.request("GET", "/tasks", {})[1]), 101)
            backup = os.path.join(directory, "backup.db")
            with (
                sqlite3.connect(path) as source,
                sqlite3.connect(backup) as destination,
            ):
                source.backup(destination)
                self.assertEqual(
                    destination.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0], "ok"
                )
            self.assertEqual(
                TaskAPI(backup).request("GET", "/tasks", {})[1],
                app.request("GET", "/tasks", {})[1],
            )
            self.assertTrue(Path("README.md").read_text().strip())
            self.assertFalse(Path("/var/run/docker.sock").exists())
            self.assertNotIn("RUNNER_TOKEN", os.environ)
